## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior, tampering, and relevant failure modes.
- [ ] `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, `mypy src`, and `pytest` pass.
- [ ] Built wheel and sdist pass integrity and isolated-install smoke checks.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] No corpus data, credentials, private keys, or generated build artifacts are included.

## Compatibility and risk

Describe manifest/hash compatibility, streaming memory, adapter, signature, performance, and migration implications.
